scope: First-wave derivative source and submitted evidence review; not security certification or integrated acceptance.
method: Skill-guided manual evidence review. No mission-assurance MCP/CLI evaluation was invoked because no tool was available; no formal evaluator output is claimed.
reviewer_execution: Read source/data/metadata only. No target imports, test commands, attacks, target code, or embedded commands executed. Only report files written.
reference_policy: All supplied HMT implementations are read-only references. Current reviewed production modules are repository-owned derivatives; selected Whisper engine remains an explicit operational asset dependency.

findings.initial_observation: Source review found no immutable target endpoint in Intent/storage; any trusted key could potentially close a different target reservation. Reviewer did not execute a counterexample.
findings.execution_evidence: Worker subsequently reproduced wrong-endpoint acceptance; raw failing JUnit is preserved in evidence/custody_endpoint_incident.json.
findings.current_observation: Intent now requires endpoint_id; stage persists target, endpoint transition rejects wrong target, reconciliation checks both intent endpoint and stored target. Worker reports same failing case now passes plus a correctly signed wrong-target proof negative; nine cumulative custody cases pass.
findings.limits: No reviewer execution, live endpoint, process-kill, full causal-family, or whole-requirement satisfaction claim. Original failing test remains; no test supersession.

findings.observation: Voice wire request no longer accepts admission. A required host callback runs before asset access and before subprocess creation. Current adapter still checks hashes before later path-based executable/model use; callbacks do not themselves serialize OS dispatch or prevent egress. docs/voice.md explicitly discloses these limits.
findings.required_evidence: Authenticated host-to-guard binding; serialized revoke/dispatch witness; immutable executable/model/backend paths; OS-denied egress observation; actual speech and resource corpus.
findings.failure_disposition: No promotion to a live voice operation until dependent host/OS/model qualification exists; no current runtime defect inferred from missing evidence.

findings.kind: Planning product is not target qualification
findings.observation: CSV read-only inspection confirms 10556 rows, 189 APPLICABLE, 10367 NOT_APPLICABLE; only NOT_EXECUTED/NOT_APPLICABLE statuses appear. Current verification evidence binds current requirements SHA. Shared pytest/unittest checks validate utilities, not independent target oracles. Trigger/hash protection does not establish authenticity or adversarial-host immutability. These limits are explicit.
findings.required_evidence: Requirement-specific executable oracles, complete declared target assertion execution, critical mutation closure, edge-specific deletion/restoration/matched/alternate-path experiments, required coverage and current cumulative regression.
findings.failure_disposition: Full target acceptance remains INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; retain every exclusion predicate and historical failure.

findings.observation: Host mutation and custody mutation use BEGIN IMMEDIATE; host offers authorize_and_checkpoint for the caller-owned connection. Decision carries effect_authority NONE. Custody authorizes inside its transaction. These source behaviors support same-file fencing only when actual composition uses the same SQLite file/connection and trusted identity/clock. Independent endpoint domains do not share instantaneous revocation.
findings.required_evidence: Actual host/custody coupled same-file test with authorize_and_checkpoint, revoke ordering, clock checkpoint rollback/commit, strict trusted identity construction, process interruption and external checkpoint recovery.
findings.failure_disposition: Keep scope at local derivative tracers; no external dispatch/release authority inferred.

limitations: Worker execution/producer records are submitted assertions until independently authenticated; SHA-256 establishes byte identity, not origin.
Host/custody composition work may continue after this snapshot; any changed reviewed digest requires reevaluation.

Full 58-requirement acceptance, actual MCP transport, live Whisper inference/microphone/UI, OS isolation/egress, hardware/storage/clock, pressure, speed, process-kill, and complete causal/mutation campaigns were not established.
Current source finding MA-001 repaired within its reported bounded tests does not erase its historical failure or authorize deployment.

addenda.method: Read-only inspection of supervisor execution records, raw JUnit, coverage metadata and coupled test source; no reviewer test/target execution.
observations: Supervisor reports 94 passing tests; raw JUnit records 94 tests, zero failures/errors/skips.
Coverage metadata reports 172 covered of 172 measured branches, zero excluded lines and zero missing branches. This denominator covers current hmt_rnd code, not full 58-requirement acceptance.

Source and submitted execution support two actual cross-worker same-file scenarios: revoked host authority preserves existing uncertainty and denies reconciliation; a backwards host clock blocks reservation and leaves intent STAGED. The callback uses authorize_and_checkpoint on the custody-owned SQLite connection.
Ruff, Pyrefly basic preset and structural/suppression gate report successful exits. Basic type checking remains explicitly labelled.
The endpoint in the coupled test is a local simulation with a permissive endpoint callback, not independent real-endpoint authority qualification.

finding_update.closed_obligation: Same-file/connection host-custody current-authority and clock checkpoint seam exercised by two bounded scenarios.
finding_update.remaining: Authenticated transport/session provisioning, process interruption/rollback anchors, independently enforced endpoint authority, hardware/clock trust, complete causal/mutation and pressure campaigns remain unqualified.
